title: Event-Study Grid: Forward Markouts from Tradeable Anchors
objective: First forward-return measurement in the program - markouts from anchor points knowable in real time, bucketed by participation, with survivorship and coverage reported alongside. Zero full-table passes over filtered_trades/filtered_quotes; every measurement derives from event_minute_bars_v2.

universe.note: Reuses the frozen 6b D1 list (identity + bitmap columns only, no D4 spine numerics). Not re-derived.

data_source.minute_index_origin: 04:00:00 ET on the session's own date (index 0), same origin every offset
data_source.hard_stop_if_scan: escalation row 3 - no pass over filtered_trades/filtered_quotes is authorized

d4.rule: All computed quantities are tick-derived from event_minute_bars_v2. No spine numeric column (OHLC/volume) may enter any computation. momentum_pct is exempt for universe selection ONLY and is PROHIBITED as a bucketing variable this phase.
d4.reused_columns_note: Both tick_close_t_minus_1_rth and day_high_ext are tick-derived (a61/6b, D4-clean: a62_d4_sweep 0 measurement-path spine hits). Reused frozen, not recomputed.

primary_clock.x_axis: minutes since 04:00 ET on T0 (extended-day clock, 0..959)
primary_clock.markouts_note: T5-T6 markouts are signed log returns and carry NO fraction-of-move denominator; the primary clock does not apply to them

t1_decomposition.target: realized_at_rth_open (6b median 0.173) decomposed into three components, each as a share of realized(09:30) and as an absolute log move

components.seg_t1_post: log move over T-1 16:00->20:00 (observable path): last_price of T-1 max-minute_index post/rth bar minus tick_close_t_minus_1_rth, in log space vs the anchor
components.seg_overnight: T-1 last extended print -> T0 first extended print (a jump, no path)
components.seg_t0_pre: T0 first extended print -> 09:30 (last T0 print at/before minute_index 330)

t1_decomposition.decomposition_definition: Additive in log space vs the anchor: realized(09:30) numerator = log(p(09:30)/tick_close_t_minus_1_rth). seg_t1_post = log(p_last_Tm1_ext / tick_close_t_minus_1_rth); seg_overnight = log(p_first_T0_ext / p_last_Tm1_ext); seg_t0_pre = log(p(09:30) / p_first_T0_ext). Sum == numerator by construction. Each reported as share of the numerator and as its absolute log value.
t1_decomposition.undefined: Events with no T-1 extended-day bars carry decomp_undefined=TRUE, reported as own row, never imputed.

clock_anchors.convention: Anchor price = last trade at or before the anchor timestamp = last_price of the T0 bar with MAX(minute_index) among minute_index <= anchor_mi (any segment). Events with no T0 print at/before an anchor are labelled anchor_undefined at that anchor, carried, reported.

anchors.name: t0_close
anchors.desc: T0 last extended-session print (max minute_index bar on T0)

participation_baseline.v0_tau: cumulative T0 extended-day volume, minute_index 0 -> tau_mi (inclusive)
participation_baseline.b_clock_tau: median over baseline_offsets of cumulative volume (minute_index 0 -> tau_mi) on that session
participation_baseline.b_session: median over baseline_offsets of full extended-session volume on that session

selection_rule.description: Pre-registered, frozen. Applied per clock anchor independently BEFORE any markout is computed. If b_clock(tau) is zero or undefined for >20% of D1 events, that anchor uses logrv_session; otherwise logrv_clock. Choice made on the undefined rate alone.

participation_baseline.no_baseline_class: Events with NO T-1/T-2/T-3 trades in v2 get participation_class='no_baseline'. Carried, labelled, never pooled into quintiles. (Escalation row 5: if no_baseline share of D1 > 5%, hard stop.)

quintiles.method: cross-sectional quintile of the selected logrv at each anchor, computed across D1 at that anchor (pd.qcut, labels 1..5, duplicates='drop'). Only the rank is used; the level is never a headline.

rung_baseline.note: Rungs are event-relative and not tied to a clock anchor tau, so the rung multiple applies to the per-event full-session baseline scalar b_session (median full extended-session volume over T-1/T-2/T-3) - the 'session' form of the T3 baseline. Frozen here before any markout.

rung_ladder.definition: First T0 minute (minute_index) at which cumulative T0 extended-day volume reaches multiple * b_session. Anchor price by the clock-anchor convention (last_price at that minute_index). Events never reaching a rung are anchor_undefined at that rung.
rung_ladder.reporting: Every rung reported. No rung may be selected, recommended, or described as preferable (escalation row 10). Attrition (count/fraction reaching each rung + crossing time-of-day distribution) is a first-class output (chart 07).

markout_grid.return_definition: Forward SIGNED log return from anchor price to horizon price: log(p_horizon / p_anchor). Long convention; sign reported as computed; NO absolute values (a negative markout is a finding).
markout_grid.horizon_undefined: Horizons past the available session end (e.g. anchor+30/+60 for a late anchor, or a missing T+1/T+3 session) are labelled horizon_undefined for that (event,anchor,horizon) cell, carried, never imputed.
markout_grid.clock_grid: anchor x participation_quintile x horizon, faceted by era. Per cell: n, median, IQR, full within-cell distribution retained.
markout_grid.rung_grid: rung x crossing_time_of_day_bin x horizon, faceted by era. Participation is constant by construction at a rung and is NOT a bucketing variable here.

crossing_time_bins.definition: ET clock time-of-day of the rung crossing minute

prohibited_bucketing: momentum_pct or any decile of it
flag_eth_dominant_t0 as a bucket (it is a chart split in T2a only)
markout_grid.prohibited_reason: All are hindsight-contaminated - the bucket assignment would already know how the day resolved (escalation rows 10, 11).

flagged_populations.note: Carried as their own labelled rows, never merged into quintiles. Counts from 6b frozen artifacts.

populations.no_baseline: computed in T3 (no T-1/T-2/T-3 trades in v2)

flagged_populations.dup_sensitivity: Report the flagship cell with and without the 7 dup-print events as a one-line sensitivity.

t2a_eth_split.flag_source: momentum_events_canonical stage t8, column flag_eth_dominant_t0 (TRUE n=736)
t2a_eth_split.flag_source_fallback: if the view is not materialized, recompute via src/data/canonical.py create_view(stage='t8'); flag is tick-derived, not D4-quarantined
t2a_eth_split.curve: pooled opportunity-decay curve (primary, 516 clock) recomputed separately for flag TRUE (736) and FALSE, with per-group n
t2a_eth_split.note: This is a CHART SPLIT only (chart 02), never a markout bucket.

t2b_row_cap.metric: per-event T=0 total print count (SUM n_trades over all T0 segments) from v2
t2b_row_cap.flags: any value at exactly 50000/100000/200000, and any count appearing across >=3 distinct events at the same exact value
t2b_row_cap.no_root_cause: do not read filtered/ parquet - out of scope

survivorship.presence: per-event presence of T+1/T+2/T+3 sessions in v2
survivorship.last_seen: per-ticker last-seen session anywhere in v2 vs event date
survivorship.report: implied post-event disappearance rate for D1, by era, with n. No external base rate, no causal language, no bias-magnitude claim.

charts.engine: plotly, standalone HTML, one per file, kaleido-verified
charts.thin_cell_rule: cells with n<100 hatched/marked thin; no claim stated from them (escalation row 8, not a stop)

config_hash_note: This file is committed before any measurement. Outputs key on its content hash.
